a.addressee: EU-based bidders in net-zero technology auctions meeting origin/resilience criteria
Households receiving support for net-zero technology purchases, including those in energy poverty

b.addressee: Member States administering net-zero technology support schemes

b_only.benefit_or_duty: Provide an accompanying document certifying a vehicle's compliance with Union origin requirements when issuing its certificate of conformity

b_only.addressee: Member States, regional or local authorities, and public-law bodies administering support schemes
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Ensure only beneficiaries meeting the low-carbon/Union-origin steel, concrete and aluminium content thresholds are eligible under household/company support schemes

b_only.addressee: Households and companies applying for building renovation, construction or motor vehicle support schemes
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Use compliant minimum shares of low-carbon/Union-origin steel, concrete and aluminium in the supported renovation/construction/vehicle project to remain eligible for the grant
Ensure new PEV/OVC-HEV/FCV purchased, leased, rented or hire-purchased through covered procurement comply with Annex III Union origin requirements
Not supply more than 50% of the value of the contracted net-zero technology product from any single individual third country for the duration of the contract.

b_only.addressee: Vehicle manufacturers/operators supplying public service contracts
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Exclude tenders from economic operators owned/controlled by entities in third countries without a guaranteeing international agreement, for net-zero technology procurement covered by the new Annex II.

b_only.addressee: Member States, regional or local authorities, and public-law bodies administering vehicle support schemes
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Ensure only Union-origin-compliant new PEV/OVC-HEV/FCV are eligible under purchase/lease/rent/hire-purchase support schemes
Guaranteed demand from vehicle purchase/lease/rental support schemes for Union-origin PEV/OVC-HEV/FCV

b_only.addressee: Foreign investors and other parties subject to a decision
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Decide on the admissibility of an FDI notification and, following any Commission opinion, issue a reasoned approval/rejection decision within fixed deadlines.
Provide accurate, non-misleading information for Commission review, on pain of penalties up to 5% of turnover or investment value
Subject acceleration-area designation plans/programmes to environmental assessment prior to adoption
Conduct and review, at least every three years, a comprehensive analysis of each acceleration area's energy needs, at minimum at designation and for milestone years 2030, 2040 and 2050
Lay down effective, proportionate and dissuasive penalty rules for infringements of the Regulation and notify the Commission of them and any amendments

b_only.addressee: Member States (via Single Digital Gateway national assistance services)
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Add a consolidated 'Permit-granting processes' information entry covering industrial manufacturing, net-zero technology and critical raw materials project permitting to the Single Digital Gateway Annex I information areas

b_only.article: Annex II Part I(a) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1735 (inserted by Article 34(8))
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Require battery energy storage systems (and above 1MWh, the battery management system) to originate in the Union in covered procurement

b_only.article: Annex II Part II(c) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1735 (inserted by Article 34(8))
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Include in auction pre-qualification/award criteria a requirement that hydrogen electrolysers, their stacks, and one additional main specific component originate in the Union

b_only.article: Regulation (EU) 2024/1735, Article 28a(1) and Annex II Part III (inserted by Article 34(6),(8))
b_only.addressee: Households and companies applying for net-zero technology demand-support schemes
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Use Union-origin battery storage, solar PV or heat pump equipment to remain eligible for the scheme or additional financial compensation

b_registered.benefit_or_duty: Guaranteed demand from corporate-vehicle financial support conditioned on Union-origin criteria

b_registered.addressee: Chemical industry manufacturers using sustainable carbon sources
b_registered.benefit_or_duty: Prospect of Union-level demand-side measures promoting production, sale and use of Union-origin substances/mixtures from sustainable carbon sources

b_registered.addressee: Industrial manufacturing project promoters in acceleration areas
b_registered.benefit_or_duty: Automatic 'strategic project' status giving priority/accelerated environmental assessment treatment for all projects in acceleration areas

b_registered.article: Annex II Part II(c) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1735 (inserted by Article 34(8))
b_registered.benefit_or_duty: Guaranteed demand for Union-origin electrolysers, stacks and main specific components in renewable-energy auctions
